newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline slips, weak NYMEX stains arb interest.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline slips, weak NYMEX stains arb interest.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices ended steady to slightly lower with a moderate selloff in NYMEX January futures discouraging further arbitrage interest, for now, traders said.
But activity was nearly dormant, with only one barge trade heard done and cargoes very quiet.
"With the way the futures came down it certainly made the arb less attractive this afternoon," a broker said. "Most cargoes being talked are for early January."
Shipping sources said Texaco fixed a clean tanker, the Zadar, for 38,000 tonnes, for loading out of Europe on January 1 headed for the U.S. Atlantic Coast.
Eurograde barges ended down $1 at $219/$221 fob ARA after trading at $223 for Rotterdam running refinery material, traders said.
CIF cargoes were seen slightly higher than that level, with fob cargoes $10 below cif, they said.
